d: This role would support the Senior Compliance Officer (SCO) in reviewing and evaluating compliance issues/concerns within the organization. The position monitors the management and employees are in compliance with the rules and regulations of regulatory agencies, that company policies and procedures are being followed, and that behavior in the organization meets the company’s Code of Conduct. This role, together with the SCO, would implement all necessary actions to ensure achievement of the objectives of an effective Compliance Program.
q: Minimum 5 years’ experience and out of which 2 years in a similar organization such as ABA is a must.
Fluent in English and Arabic (written and oral).
Ability to work independently and in a team.
Shows an interest in industry bodies and a willingness to contribute and share knowledge.
Good drafting skills and the ability to interpret business processes into legally sound documents.
Able to interact confidently with senior executives.
Focused individual who is able to execute effectively, planning own outputs and meet specified deadlines.
Good interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively, professional, diplomatic, cordial and collaborate sensitively with others.
Ability to influence and build good relationships at all levels in order to effectively carry out responsibilities.
Be able to conduct meetings and presentations skilfully.
Ability to draft high quality communication material.
r: Assist and support the development, initiation and maintenance of policies and procedures for the general operation of the Compliance Program and its related activities to prevent illegal, unethical, or improper conduct.
Collaborates with other departments (e.g., Internal Audit, GHRD, etc.) to gather information of direct compliance issues and reports the same to SCO.
Support the SCO with alleged violations of rules, regulations, policies, procedures, and Code of Conduct by conducting investigative procedures.
Responsible to review, evaluate and follow up the compliance Issues/concerns are been worked on by the relevant management and employees.
Identifies potential areas of compliance vulnerability and risk; reports the same to SCO.
Responsible to monitor corrective action plans recommended by SCO for resolution of problematic issues.
Provides reports on a regular basis of the operation and progress of compliance efforts to SCO.
Ensures proper reporting of violations or potential violations to SCO.
Responsible for the management of the compliance Hotline.

Support SCO in effective compliance communication program for the organization, including promoting (a) use of the Compliance Hotline; (b) heightened awareness of Code of Conduct, and (c) understanding of new and existing compliance issues and related policies and procedures.
Compliance assessment, which involves analyzing compliance of laws, policies and code of conduct.
Analyze all relevant compliance related reports (internal or external findings).
Support implementation of compliance related training / awareness initiatives.
Uses innovative solutions to facilitate not just a process but a mindset change or improvement at multiple functional levels.

d: We are seeking a customer-focused Remote Customer Care Associate to support individuals by delivering timely assistance, resolving concerns, and creating positive service experiences. This opportunity is ideal for candidates who enjoy communication, problem-solving, and helping customers receive the support they need.

The successful candidate will manage customer interactions, provide accurate responses, maintain service records, and assist with improving customer satisfaction. You will work remotely while collaborating with internal teams to ensure enquiries are handled efficiently and customers receive consistent, professional support.
q: Strong communication and active listening skills.
Ability to remain calm under pressure.
Ability to learn new systems quickly.
Comfortable working with online communication tools.
Previous customer care, customer service, or support experience preferred.
Experience with digital communication platforms is beneficial.
Strong interpersonal skills are valued for entry-level applicants.
r: Assist customers with enquiries, requests, and account-related questions.
Provide accurate and helpful information through available support channels.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions.
Resolve issues while following company procedures.
Identify customer needs and provide suitable solutions.
Maintain a professional and empathetic communication style.
Monitor follow-up activities and pending requests.
